_readme: The flyer page (/flyer/ and /es/flyer/): the committee's official flyer (English), its downloads, the printable posters and the flyer's full text. en and es must have the same keys. Plain text unless noted: englishNote, stale.text and text.body accept simple Markdown. Write the date, times, Zoom numbers and file sizes only as tokens ({date}, {time}, {start}, {startEs}, {pdfSize}, {jpgSize}, {domain}…); the Zoom ID, passcode and link in the flyer's text come from site.json. Never write {email} here: the footer prints the address on every page, so the flyer's text links to it (i18n contact.linkText).

meta.title: The official flyer
meta.description: The official flyer for The Incredible Tapestry, a free 1-day online A.A. workshop on {date}, {timeShort}. Download it as a PDF or a print-quality image, or print the light-background poster.

hero.title: The official flyer
hero.lead: Download it, print it for your home group’s bulletin board, or pass it along to your sponsees, district and intergroup.

text.hint: For screen readers, translation tools and anyone who prefers text
text.title: The Incredible Tapestry
text.subline: How the Steps, Traditions and Concepts weave this incredible tapestry
text.body: Come join us for a 1-day, online Incredible Tapestry workshop similar to the Tapestry meetings held previously in Raynham, Mass. Starting at {start}, there will be a series of presentations which look at how the Steps, Traditions and Concepts weave this incredible tapestry with plenty of time for sharing and asking questions.
text.cost: The meeting is free, but there will be some expenses for interpretation, which will be provided in Spanish and ASL, and contributions will be welcomed. No pre-registration is required.
text.program: The program will be available on the website, {domain}, shortly.

text.hint: En español, para lectores de pantalla, traductores y quien prefiera leer el texto
text.overline: Un taller en línea de un día
text.title: The Incredible Tapestry
text.subline: Cómo los Pasos, las Tradiciones y los Conceptos entretejen este increíble tapiz
text.body: Los invitamos a acompañarnos en The Incredible Tapestry, un taller en línea de un día parecido a las reuniones Tapestry que se realizaron anteriormente en Raynham, Massachusetts. A partir de las {startEs}, habrá una serie de presentaciones sobre cómo los Pasos, las Tradiciones y los Conceptos entretejen este increíble tapiz, con bastante tiempo para compartir y hacer preguntas.
text.cost: El taller es gratuito, pero la interpretación, que se ofrecerá en español y en ASL, tendrá algunos gastos, y se agradecerán las contribuciones. No se requiere inscripción previa.
text.program: El programa estará disponible próximamente en el sitio web, {domain}.
